name: commute-help
description: Local-first road closure and commute planning for Portland-Vancouver

scripts.dev: node scripts/print-startup.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta ".venv/bin/python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.test: npm run test:campaign && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
